page.overview:
Who is Gary?

Ensign Gary was a Starfleet operations division officer who served aboard a space station located in the Sol system located near Luna in Earth's orbit.

In 2381, Gary was playing a computer game version of three-dimensional chess when he was notified by his co-worker that the was making an unscheduled departure from its assigned space dock, prompting Gary to put the station on red alert. ()
